chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The greatest of people in status with Allah on the Day of Resurrection is the one who walks most in His earth with sincere advice to His creatures.'

key_terms.أَرْضِهِ: His earth (referring to the domain of creation)
key_terms.أَمْشَاهُمْ: the one who walks most (superlative of walking/moving)

ai.seo_question: Who has the highest status with Allah on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to underscore that the highest status on the Day of Judgment belongs to those who actively disseminate sincere counsel (nasihah) among creation. This hadith contextualizes the concept of nasihah not merely as verbal advice, but as a comprehensive, active engagement with the world, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interplay between knowledge and practical guidance in achieving spiritual elevation.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The greatest of the people in status in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> on the Day of Judgement is the one most striving in His<sup>azwj</sup> earth with the advising to His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Of the people of the greatest position before Allah on the Day of Judgment will be he who is a person walking on earth the most to provide good advice to His creatures.’”
